name: wide_bn_view_aligned_kd
teacher_rule: three fixed wide_bn checkpoints; teacher probabilities averaged after temperature scaling

permissions.valid_labels: predeclared checkpoint selection and metrics only

input.augmentation: matched conditions use source-only span mask p0.5, 90 bins; clean condition uses no mask

model.architecture: wide progressive generator + BatchNorm + unchanged Transformer

distillation.target: mean of three teacher softmax probabilities after temperature scaling
distillation.matched_kd: teachers and student receive exactly the same masked batch
distillation.clean_kd: teachers and student receive clean source batch
distillation.gated_matched_kd: matched target retained only when mean teacher confidence >=0.8 and three teacher argmax votes are not all equal

checkpoint_selection: maximum valid accuracy, earliest strict improvement
scope: TemporalDrift source/valid development only; no future, WTT-Time, AWF, TTA or external evaluation
